title: Memoization decorator returns results for the wrong keyword arguments

cases.name: keyword_variants_are_separate_entries
cases.code:
calls = []
@sol.memoize
def pow_(b, e=2):
    calls.append((b, e))
    return b ** e
out = [pow_(3), pow_(3, e=3), pow_(3)]
result = (out, pow_.hits, pow_.misses, calls)

cases.name: keyword_order_does_not_matter
cases.code:
calls = []
@sol.memoize
def g(a=0, b=0):
    calls.append((a, b))
    return a * 10 + b
out = [g(a=1, b=2), g(b=2, a=1)]
result = (out, g.hits, g.misses, calls)

cases.name: explicit_keyword_vs_default_differ
cases.code:
calls = []
@sol.memoize
def f(b, e=2):
    calls.append((b, e))
    return b ** e
out = [f(3), f(3, e=2), f(3, 2)]
result = (out, f.hits, f.misses, calls)

cases.name: positional_vs_keyword_differ
cases.code:
calls = []
@sol.memoize
def f(x):
    calls.append(x)
    return x + 1
out = [f(1), f(x=1), f(1), f(x=1)]
result = (out, f.hits, f.misses, calls)
